safety.warningLine: 本片含有闪烁画面与强光，光敏感者请留意
safety.note: preroll = seconds of silent warning page BEFORE the song. Every time in shots/ is song time (audio start = 0), so no cue moves; film time = song time + preroll. maxFlash caps every full-screen flash and is asserted by tools/check-storyboard.mjs. flashRange is not typed here: the storyboard computes it from the shots that actually carry flash.

beat.note: Read from the feature table, not typed. Every cut must land on a beat, half-beat or bar line; tools/check-storyboard.mjs enforces it.
